summary: PR-1994 adds AppLog.last() to the mortgage logging component, which is security-sensitive. CHG-5 therefore requires a security_review approval, and none exists, so the change must be rejected. In addition, the CI JUnit reports appear to come from a developer workstation, with timestamps that predate the commit, so testing on the final commit is not reliably evidenced. LOG-1 has only sample-coverage evidence against an exhaustive requirement.
